subject.title: fix(cron): detect ===DONE_ERR=== sentinel in agent final text as failure signal

question: Should a terminal `===DONE_ERR===` string in an agent's free-form final answer be a supported durable cron-failure protocol, or must cron failures arrive only as structured runtime signals?
rationale: This choice changes durable status and alert semantics for existing cron jobs and cannot be resolved safely by relocating the same text parsing between callers.

options.title: Require structured failures
options.body: Keep final text presentation-only and add or use a producer-owned structured failure signal for runs that must affect cron state.

options.title: Adopt the sentinel protocol
options.body: Document `===DONE_ERR===` as a stable cron contract, define escaping and false-positive behavior, and add upgrade and end-to-end coverage before merging.

recommendation.title: Require structured failures
recommendation.body: Keep final text presentation-only and add or use a producer-owned structured failure signal for runs that must affect cron state.
